source.label: positions of the published map (one per 10 min) and exact boundaries of its signal gaps

A.expected: silence of 45 min while crossing a restricted area: the gap should be reconstructed with a high probability of passage through a restricted area

B.expected: positions shifted by 10 km for 20 min with unchanged timestamps: integrity alert (position jump) and the shifted block set aside, then reconstructed

C.expected: gap of 45 min far from any zone and buffer: low probability of passage (negative control)

fleet_excluding_listed_mmsi.excluded: data/private/excluded_from_stats.csv absent: only the three copies are excluded

reading: Expected behaviour on the three copies is checked from their description; with the internal files present, the real positions during the window are compared with the 90 % contour. Fleet figures exclude the listed MMSI. A flagged vessel is a review priority, never an offence.
